scientific.integrity: The conserved quadratic form is explicitly credited as a scalar specialization of later unconstrained alternating-gradient energy conservation; the claimed contribution is the sharp projection-boundary threshold and its exact constrained periodic consequences.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is local to the projection-free neighborhood of the scalar LP and does not classify global projected dynamics or the zero-start orbit for every small step.

title: A sharp projection-free invariant neighborhood for the He--You--Yuan PDHG counterexample
